title: A Postcard for the Harbor
author: Edmund Crane
blurb: Zephyrine Coldharbour, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
